```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)'
        required: true
        default: '50'
        type: number

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name || '' }}
      BRANCH: instantsearch-${{ github.event.release.tag_name || '' }}-docs
    steps:
      - name: Checkout this repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up environment variables
        run: |
          echo "TAG=${{ github.event.release.tag_name || '' }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "BRANCH=instantsearch-${{ github.event.release.tag_name || '' }}-docs" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Claude Code (if requested)
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt_file: .github/claude-code/prompt.md
          max_turns: ${{ inputs.max_turns }}
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          timeout_minutes: 15
        id: claude

      - name: Dry run message
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'false' }}
        run: |
          echo "Dry run: no changes will be made."
          echo "Run Claude Code with 'run_claude: true' to generate changes."
          echo "Create PR with 'create_pr: true' to push changes to docs-new."

      - name: Clone docs-new repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: algolia/docs-new
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          path: docs-new
          ref: main

      - name: Apply Claude changes to docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          git config user.email "bot@algolia.com"
          git config user.name "instantsearch-bot"
          # Apply the patch generated by Claude
          git apply ../${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }}
          git add .
          git diff --cached --name-only | tee ../changed_files.txt
          git commit -m "Update docs for InstantSearch $TAG"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}

      - name: Show changes (preview mode)
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' && inputs.create_pr == 'false' }}
        run: |
          echo "The following files would be changed:"
          cat changed_files.txt || echo "No changes detected."

      - name: Push changes to new branch (full run)
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' && inputs.create_pr == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          git push --set-upstream origin "$BRANCH"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}

      - name: Create draft PR in docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' && inputs.create_pr == 'true' }}
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          args: |
            pr create \
              --draft \
              --title "Update docs for InstantSearch $TAG" \
              --body "Automated docs update for release $TAG. Please review the changes." \
              --reviewer frontend-experiences-web \
              --base main \
              --head $BRANCH
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
```
